title: Homemade Dahi

items: 600 grams milk, i use full fat milk here, feel free to use low fat if you please :)

method: If using packet milk, you need to boil it and allow it to cool to warm
If using tetra pack milk, you need to heat it mildly, no need to boil
Add in 2 tbsps of the culture you have and mix it till combined
Let it set for 4-6 hours dont disturb it then place in the fridge to get cool for another few hours and enjoy :)
tips: The longer you leave it out, the more sour it will become so if making it to use in kadi, leave it out atleast 3 hours more than you would to make a nice tangy kadi :)

HOMEMADE DAHI RECIPE 
home food 101

Nutrition: 
C: 5 | F: 4 | P: 3
Calories: 67 per 100 grams 
Makes 600 grams of dahi

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Ingredients
600 grams milk, i use full fat milk here, feel free to use low fat if you please :) 
2 tbsp dahi culture 

Method
if using packet milk, you need to boil it and allow it to cool to warm 
if using tetra pack milk, you need to heat it mildly, no need to boil 
add in 2 tbsps of the culture you have and mix it till combined 
(if there is froth on top 
let it set for 4-6 hours dont disturb it then place in the fridge to get cool for another few hours and enjoy :) 

pro tip: the longer you leave it out, the more sour it will become so if making it to use in kadi, leave it out atleast 3 hours more than you would to make a nice tangy kadi :)
